tc01.steps:
Load the firmware on the firewall and boot with default settings. Configure LAN and WAN interfaces,and proper DNS server On the Network > Address Objects page, add FQDN AO with the name "fqdn test"
WAN zone assignment and www.google.com FQDN hostname. 4.check if added FQDN AO can be resolved with ipv6 host
tc01.title: Add IPv6 FQDN AO, check if it can be can be resolved with ipv6 host
tc01.description: check if added FQDN AO can be resolved with ipv6 host
tc01.result: FQDN AO can be resolved with ipv6 host

tc04.steps:
configure dns server ,add a domain name like
snwl.com with 30 ipv6 hosts and 30 ipv4 hosts
a.snwl.com with 30 ipv6 hosts and 30 ipv4 hosts
2. add a FQDN AO conclude wildcard like *.snwl.com
3. check the AO can be solved
4. ping a.snwl.com,check the resolved host can be added the AO
tc04.title: add IPv6 FQDN AO conclude wildcard.
tc04.result: In step 4,the FQDN AO include wildcard.can be added successfully.

tc05.steps:
go to diag.html page
enable option"Refresh sub-domains of wildcard FQDN address objects "
sub-domains of wildcard FQDN address objects will fresh after TTL expired and offset time elapsed
disable option"Refresh sub-domains of wildcard FQDN address objects "
sub-domains of wildcard FQDN address objects will delete after TTL expired and offset time elapsed
tc05.title: Test option"Refresh sub-domains of wildcard FQDN address objects  " in diag page

tc07.steps:
configure dns server ,add a domain name like 1.snwl.com with 4 ipv6 hosts
2. add a FQDN AO 1.snwl.com,check if it can be resolved with 4 ipv6 hosts
3. configure dns server, add another host ip to the domain name
4. wait for a while,check if the FQDN AO can be resolved with 5 ipv6 hosts.
tc07.title: Function test when the resolved IPv6 addresses increased
tc07.result: in step4,the FQDN AO can be resolved with increased host ip

tc08.steps:
configure dns server ,add a domain name like 1.snwl.com with 4 ipv6 hosts.
2. add a FQDN AO 1.snwl.com,check if it can be resolved with 4 ipv6 hosts.
3. configure dns server, delete a ipv6 host to the domain name
4. wait for a while,check if the FQDN AO can be resolved with 3 ipv6 hosts.
tc08.title: Function test when the resolved IPv6 addresses decreased
tc08.result: in step4,the FQDN AO can be solved with decreased host ip

tc10.steps:
add a FQDN AO which can resolved IPV6 address such as www.google.com
2. enable " Manually set DNS entries' TTL ",set TTL to 150.
3. check if resolved ipv6 hosts with TTL 150
4. wait for TTL expired and offset time elapsed,check if SonicOS resend dns qurey,and then mark the TTL with set value.
tc10.title: test option " Manually set DNS entries' TTL " on IPv6 FQND AO page
tc10.result: option " Manually set DNS entries' TTL " work normally

tc12.steps:
add a FQDN AO which can resolved IPV6 address such as www.google.com
2. wait for TTL expired and offset time elapsed,from captured packet check if SonicOS resend dns qurey.
tc12.title: Verify when one of the binding host's TTL has expired,
tc12.result: in step 2,from captured packet will find SonicOS resend dns qurey.

tc18.steps:
Log->setting,enable Display Events in Log Monitor,and set the interval time to 0
2. Add a FQDN AO like www.google.com
3. wait for a while,check log If show" Added host entry to dynamic address object"
tc18.title: Log support: Added Host Entry to dynamic address object
tc18.result: " Added host entry to dynamic address object" is shown in log

tc25.steps:
add a ipv6 FQDN,eg ipv6.google.com
2. add an access rule ,from lan to wan,source any ,dest ipv6.google.com,action as deny
3. from lan pc,ping ipv6.google.com
4. add access rule from dmz/wlan/custom zone to wan zone ,and use FQDN ipv6 AO,repeat step 2 and 3
tc25.title: IPv6_FQDN_ACL: Deny ACL (LAN-WAN)

tc26.steps:
add a ipv6 FQDN,eg ipv6.google.com
2. add an access rule ,from lan to wan,source any ,dest ipv6.google.com,action as allow
3. from lan pc,ping ipv6.google.com
4. add access rule from dmz/wlan/custom zone to wan zone ,and use FQDN ipv6 AO,repeat step 2 and 3
tc26.title: IPV6 FQDN_ACL: Allowed ACL (LAN-WAN)

tc28.steps:
1.add a network monitor policy, add a probe target,create new ipv6 FQDN,eg ipv6.google.com
2. choose probe type to ping
3. check if the policy can be added successfully and if it can be probe
tc28.title: Add a FQDN based IPv6 Network monitor policy with newly created FQDN Aos

tc30.steps:
add a network monitor policy, add a probe target,use a ipv6 FQDN AO,e.g.ipv6.google.com
2. choose probe type to ping,choose version IPv6
3. check if the policy can be added successfully and if it can be probe
tc30.title: Add a FQDN based IPv6 Network monitor policy and choose version IPv6 and make sure it works as expected.

tc35.steps:
1.network->dns proxy, enabled option "Enforce DNS Proxy For All DNS Requests ".
2.network->address object,add a unsolved FQDN AO like hdhdhdhsjsj.com
3.network->dns proxy,enable dns cache,and add a static cache for hdhdhdhsjsj.com
4.after a while,check this AO can be resolved Note:In step 2,if the FQDN AO is unresolved,in step 4,it will take several minutes or click refresh button correctly to update the resolved ip. In step 2, if the FQDN AO is resolved,in step 4,click purge button,it canupdate the resolved ip instantly.
tc35.title: Binding test between FQDN AO and DNS Proxy(enforced DNS proxy must be enabled): Add a FQDN AO first and it is unresolved, then add a static DNS cache about this domain
